svg.title: LLM Guardrails Gateway — Full Underlying Logic (OSS Zero-API variant)
svg.desc: End-to-end flow: Clients -> Nginx -> FastAPI Gateway -> Auth -> Abuse/Ratelimit -> Input Guardrails (+OPA) -> Memory Recall -> LLM (Ollama) -> Output Guardrails -> Memory Extract -> Postgres/Redis/Qdrant -> Observability
svg.text: Request → Nginx → FastAPI → Auth → Abuse • RateLimit → Input Guardrails (+OPA) → Memory Recall → LLM (Ollama local) → Output Guardrails → Memory Extract → Postgres/Redis/Qdrant → Response • Zero-API OSS variant highlighted

g.text: + Security headers (HSTS • CSP • X-Frame) + Sentry before_send(scrub_text) + JSONFormatter(SecretScrubFilter) → PostHog • GlitchTip
X-Api-Key: grg_… (bcrypt) • Authorization: Bearer grg_ / Clerk JWT / local JWT
AbuseProtection: gap 2s • inflight 1 • tarpit 1s*2^n • bot list • XFF only behind proxy
RateLimit: RPM/RPD per key (Redis Lua ZCARD) • api_key_protection: RPM>120 • burn>50k/5m • IP≥5 • blocked≥80% → ban 15m→24h
Redis shared or in-memory fallback • /admin/bans + unban
token_wallet: estimate len/4 + max_tokens → require_balance → deduct → daily_budget → dedup 5m
Stripe → Lago/KillBill or wallet-only (BILLING_ENABLED=false → instant credit)
POSTHOG self-host • SENTRY → GlitchTip • before_send scrub
INPUT GUARDRAILS — guardrails/input.py • block or pass • fail-closed on OPA
rust engine (guardrail_core PyO3) → python fallback • findings[] → OPA
LLM ROUTER — app/services/llm/ → Ollama local ◀ OSS
call_llm • stream_llm • fallbacks • cache (Redis) • LiteLLM ollama/ prefix
secret_leakage (gsk_ in response → block) • toxic • topic • schema • validators
delivered + LLM text → llm_extract_memories(heuristic→LLM JSON) → create_memory ×2 → commit
_log_request: prompt_hash SHA256 • preview [REDACTED] • full_prompt Fernet • fired_rule
secret scrub on preview/reason/full_prompt + egress middleware
DATA PLANE — docker-compose internal network (no public ports except web:8080)
* request_logs: prompt_hash SHA256 • preview scrub • full_prompt Fernet AES-GCM • api_key FK SET NULL • analytics MVs refresh CONCURRENTLY
SIDE CARS — internal only (expose 8181/50051/4000 not published)
web:80 proxies → api:8000, elixir:4000 • security headers • robots.txt • security.txt • static /assets
SecretScrubFilter • before_send • SecretScrubMiddleware (egress) • request_logging scrub(path) • webhook error scrub
LEGEND — zero-API OSS swaps (env only, code unchanged)
Solid = sync request path • Dashed = async (webhook, vector upsert, PostHog capture, Elixir notify). Fail-closed: OPA timeout → block. Read-only GraphQL. 7 middlewares. 267 tests.
.env example → docs/OSS_REPLACEMENTS.md — copy zero-API env, `docker compose --profile oss up` (add ollama/qdrant/posthog/glitchtip/keycloak).
